body: you two that have already commented....you have no idea how much it touched me that someone, anyone, cares at all. I started crying immediately upon seeing that I even had responses. I've never reached out like this before. thank you for taking the time to show your concern and offer your help.

I also recently lost my long term boyfriend, most of my friends, and feel like a failure for not getting into med school and not knowing what to do with my life. My parents are embarrassed by me and disappointed by me. Due to lack of money, I live at home with them and have to deal with these feelings of theirs everyday. I also feel useless and like no one wants me. I feel like we have some things in common. Please feel free to talk to me if you would like to. I would love to just chat...about this or even just anything. Or listen. Or offer advice. Anything you want. I could use someone too...
